scenes.narration: Pasting client details into an AI chat takes a second.
Outbound Veil watches the field you are typing in, on your Mac, and marks personal details as you type.
Names, birth dates, Social Security, phone, email and card numbers are marked right where they are.
Open the list and redact everything in one click, or ignore a finding. Nothing you type leaves your Mac.
Free for seven days, then twenty-nine dollars, once. macOS 14 or later.
